plan.source_choice: Fixed held-out source families10/14/25; exclude all selected reviewed examples and their complete families, including02/03.
plan.candidate_universe: Main-deck printings in the pinned27-list source bank; exact cost/type/arena/aspect signature, novel canonical name/subtitle absent source, admitted full resulting declaration and complete sourceIr/dataOnly runtime-admitted IR.
plan.pool_rule: For each slot use exact-power/HP pool if it has>=2 alternatives with different IR distances; otherwise exact-core pool is a separately labeled confounded exploratory stratum. Choose strict slots first, then source code. No vector results used.
plan.selection: At most2 slots/source, source count>=2; independently min/max IR-only distance with printed-code tie break; no printed traits/keywords/stats in that selection distance.

proxy.path_matching: exact typed all-side ordered JSON path, containers retained; object keys sorted; root ability display title excluded
proxy.numeric: abs(x-y)/max(1,abs(x),abs(y)); unmatched path/type is1; categorical mismatch is1; each group mean then equal group mean
proxy.semantics: Structural proxy only, no execution or strategic meaning; no textual similarity or learned parameters

plan.invariance: Original anchor, reordered entries, expanded/split entries, and one genuine policy-admitted reprint if available; canonical and encoded-feature equality checked.
plan.prior_controls: New fixed operators/seeds; exclude any candidate composition identical to a previous reserved counterfactual; no prior scores/ranks read or used.

limitations: Near/far is defined by a fixed IR structural proxy, not behavioral distance, beneficial synergy, semantic ground truth or strength.
Selecting proxy extremes makes that proxy an oracle for its own labels. It is a declared comparison baseline, not independent validation of semantic correctness.
Strict exact-power/HP controls and prespecified power/HP-confounded fallback controls must be reported separately, never pooled as an unconfounded primary result.
Three source families are the independent roots; doses, variants and invariance views are dependent observations, not an enlarged population sample.

Unreviewed means absent from selected reviewer examples and their whole source families. Original vectors were already part of the global27-deck inventory; no claim of never-inspected original vectors is made.
Whole-card runtime admission is loader/schema evidence, not gameplay conformance or measured effects. No native runtime execution is performed here.
Unsupported/incomplete IR is explicitly unknown, never the zero-effect program. Shared unknown unchanged deck cards limit full-deck proxy coverage.
Canonical identity/permutation/reprint controls test representation correctness, not strategic quality; several views have the same composition.
No neural forward, neighbor metric, classifier, fit, engine call, paid job or opponent/private-state access occurs during preparation.
